verdict.rationale: AiPrise claims real-time screening against adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists "all through one API". It also says it adjudicates watchlist alerts before they reach the review queue, where every case has an owner and can be routed to an analyst or EDD. That covers the one-vendor, one-API, one-review-surface core. The evidence is homepage marketing rather than in-depth docs, and it does not explicitly show screening embedded as a step within an individual user's verification flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that screening runs inside the same individual-user verification session, API reference detail for screening results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface

citations.quote: Screen adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists in real time - all through one API.
Screens against watchlists and adjudicates alerts, clearing the noise before it ever hits your queue.
Every case has an owner: assign to an analyst or route to Enhanced Due Diligence.
